name: smwmusic-varth-operation-thunder-storm-stage
title: Varth: Operation Thunder Storm - Stage 14 (Remix)
description:
Your voyage into the outer reaches of space is just beginning... but are you ready for the oncoming onslaught?

Or something like that, I don't know the plot of this game. But I do know this tune is a banger, and so we felt compelled to spin together this remix inspired by Axelay, and likewise used Axelay's samples.

This also won 2nd place in the Covers category of Super Famicompo 7! Ain't that neat?
